title: CA Credentials CoAP resource (§8.13.2)
description: Implement portable CA credential handling from spec §8.13.2. Nodes present CA-signed COSE_Sign1 credentials containing x5chain. Resource: POST /.well-known/auth with credential, gateway validates chain against trust store and caches for session. Claims: oidc:name, oidc:email, lichen:fleet, lichen:role, lichen:emergency. Credential presentation protocol per spec §8.13 verification steps 1-7. Depends on trust store resource and cert profile.
